name: social-growth-engineers
description: Research what makes consumer apps grow on TikTok and Instagram: viral video breakdowns, hook trends, app strategies and published case studies.

interface.longDescription:
Research what makes consumer apps grow on TikTok and Instagram. Social Growth Engineers studies thousands of short-form videos that drove app downloads and breaks down why they worked: the hook, the format, the pacing, the on-screen text.

Without an account you can search and read Social Growth Engineers' published articles and case studies. Sign in with your Social Growth Engineers account to search the viral video library, see shot-by-shot breakdowns, explore which hook patterns are rising or fading, compare app strategies, and generate a shareable research report.

Results link back to the original posts so you can watch each video where it was published.
capabilities: Search articles and case studies on app growth
Find viral TikTok and Instagram videos for an app or niche
Break down a video's hook, pacing and on-screen text
Show which hook patterns are rising or declining
Find apps similar to a given app and how they grew
defaultPrompt: Find case studies about TikTok hooks for subscription apps
Show viral TikTok videos for meditation apps and break down their hooks
Which hook patterns are rising for fitness apps right now?
